items.name: X01_linen_wrap
items.text: linen bandage being wrapped tightly around a body, soft dry cloth rustle and gentle pulling, close and intimate, no music

items.name: X02_canopic_lid
items.text: a small carved stone lid set down onto a ceramic jar, one soft clink and a short gritty scrape, close and dry

items.name: X03_natron_pour
items.text: dry coarse salt poured from a clay bowl onto linen, fine granular trickle, close

items.name: X04_papyrus_unroll
items.text: an old dry papyrus scroll unrolled across a wooden table, crisp crackling paper rustle

items.name: X05_reed_pen
items.text: a reed pen writing on papyrus, three scratchy strokes and a light tap into an ink palette, close

items.name: X06_boat_oars
items.text: wooden oars dipping slowly into calm dark river water, rhythmic strokes, a wooden boat creaking softly, cavernous echo, quiet, seamless loop

items.name: X07_serpent_hiss
items.text: a large serpent hissing, one long sharp hiss swelling and fading, close

items.name: X08_bronze_gate
items.text: heavy bronze temple gate creaking open slowly, metallic groan with a low resonant hum, ends with a soft thud

items.name: X09_judges_whisper
items.text: a crowd of forty people whispering in a large stone hall, many overlapping hushed voices, no intelligible words, reverberant, seamless loop

items.name: X10_scarab_clack
items.text: a small hard stone amulet dropped onto a stone floor, one sharp clack and a tiny bounce, dry

items.name: X11_feather_land
items.text: a single feather drifting down and landing, soft airy whoosh ending in one tiny delicate bell chime

items.name: X12_scale_ding
items.text: small brass balance scale pans coming level, one clear soft metallic ding with a gentle ring-out

items.name: X13_ammit_gulp
items.text: cartoon monster gulp, a big wet comedic swallow followed by a small satisfied grunt

items.name: X14_reeds_birds_water
items.text: peaceful riverbank of tall reeds, gentle flowing water, soft birdsong, warm sunny morning, seamless loop

items.name: X15_sickle_wheat
items.text: a bronze sickle cutting through a handful of dry wheat stalks, two crisp swishes and snaps, close

items.name: X16_shabti_clatter
items.text: many small clay figurines rattling and clattering on a stone shelf as they come to life, tiny ceramic clicks and scuttling

items.name: X17_heart_on_pan
items.text: a soft wet fleshy object placed onto a bronze scale pan, a muffled thump and a faint metallic ring

items.name: X18_scale_tip_heavy
items.text: a bronze balance scale tipping hard to one side, chains rattling and a heavy metal clunk
